core: Protein N-glycosylation and GPI anchor biosynthesis
qualifier: dolichol and nucleotide-sugar precursors with congenital glycosylation disorders
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycosylation, GPI anchoring and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover dolichol, GDP-mannose and UDP-sugar precursor synthesis, nucleotide-sugar transport, N-glycan assembly/processing and GPI anchoring, mostly as CDG gene defects, whereas the confusables centre on sialic acid and amino-sugar metabolism.

core: Selective autophagy and autophagosome assembly control
name: Organelle-selective, micro- and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: All members concern autophagic cargo delivery (pexophagy, reticulophagy, mitophagy, aggrephagy, microautophagy, CMA) and its assembly regulation, while confusables emphasise PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial dynamics, xenophagy or aggresome/ERAD quality control.

name: ERBB4 receptor signaling, including nuclear ERBB4 action
rationale: Members describe ERBB4 homo- and heterodimer signaling, its PI3K, nuclear and downregulation branches and ERBB3 signaling, distinct from confusables built on ERBB2/EGFR, MET, PTK6 or IGF1R/ALK.

name: SWI/SNF BAF chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: Every member is formation of a BAF complex variant (cBAF, ncBAF, pBAF, esBAF, npBAF/nBAF), unlike confusables on CHD remodelers, histone acetylation or apoptotic chromatin.

name: Mitochondrial presequence processing and protein degradation
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial signal/presequence peptide processing and intramitochondrial proteolysis, whereas confusables are about protein import, cristae or SMDT1/calcium uptake.

name: Gland, thymus, spleen and trachea organogenesis
rationale: Members are development of endocrine and exocrine glands (thyroid, parathyroid, salivary, lacrimal, mammary), thymus, spleen, bile duct and trachea, while confusables are craniofacial, palate and inner/outer ear morphogenesis.

qualifier: collagen/VWF adhesion and agonist receptor signaling
name: Platelet adhesion, agonist-receptor activation and degranulation
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion via GPVI and VWF-GPIb, thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling and degranulation, unlike confusables on the plasma coagulation cascade or integrin/cytoskeletal and G12/13 modules.

name: Chromatin remodeler and corepressor regulation of transcription
rationale: Members involve NuRD, CHD6-9, ChAHP, Polycomb and CTCF/cohesin chromatin regulators, arginine methylation and SUMOylation of cofactors controlling genes such as PTEN and PD-L1, whereas confusables focus on BAF assembly, histone acetylation or lysine methylation/DNA methylation.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum release, reuptake and store-operated entry
name: Intracellular calcium release, reuptake and entry in muscle
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic and SR calcium via ryanodine receptors, SERCA, Na/Ca exchange and store-operated entry to control cardiac and skeletal contraction, while confusables concern fibre-type switching, action potentials or gap-junction conduction.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfide catabolism plus vitamin B6 activation and molybdenum cofactor synthesis that serve it, unlike confusables on BH4/phenylalanine, serine/proline or selenium metabolism.

name: Factor VIII and IX defects in intrinsic coagulation
rationale: All members are defective F8 or F9 functions plus the intrinsic pathway itself, whereas confusables cover FXII/kallikrein, FV, VWF, fibrin formation and fibrinolysis.

name: Classical and alternative complement activation and regulation
rationale: Members describe classical and alternative complement activation and its positive and negative control, while confusables carry the lectin and GZMK pathways, C3/C5 activation, opsonization or hypersensitivity.

name: Astrocyte activation, reactive gliosis and glial migration
rationale: Members concern astrocyte activation, reactive gliosis, glial proliferation and migration, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelin formation.

qualifier: proliferation, survival, CD27 and germinal center control
name: B cell proliferation, survival and germinal center regulation
rationale: Members regulate B cell proliferation, apoptosis, homeostasis, B-1 differentiation, CD27 signaling and germinal center formation, whereas confusables emphasise BCR signal generation, Tfh/ICOS help or B cell expression modules.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 signaling and its downregulation
rationale: Members are TGF-beta/SMAD2/3:SMAD4 signaling and its negative regulation, unlike confusables on RUNX3, TGFBR3/activin or cancer mutants of the pathway.

qualifier: glycosylase incision through short- and long-patch gap filling
name: Base excision repair, glycosylase incision to patch gap-filling
rationale: Members follow BER from glycosylase recognition and base cleavage (incl. NEIL1/NEIL3) through AP-site processing and POLB/PCNA gap filling, while confusables cover OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects or alkylation reversal and DNA demethylation.

name: B cell antigen receptor signaling and B cell development
rationale: Members cover BCR second-messenger, BTK, RAS and CD22 signaling with B cell development, plus leukocyte-brake and myeloid kinase modules, distinguishing it from confusables on CD27/germinal center or generic lymphocyte expression clusters.

core: Cell adhesion to collagen and laminin matrix
name: Integrin and VWF adhesion to collagen and laminin matrix
rationale: Members combine integrin, laminin and collagen-receptor interactions, collagen trimerization/anchoring fibrils and VWF-collagen-GPIb variants, while confusables are hemidesmosome assembly, collagen crosslinking or platelet activation.

name: AMPA and kainate receptor excitatory transmission
rationale: Members are AMPA and Na-/Ca-permeable kainate receptor activation, excitatory transmission, short-term plasticity and kainate-induced neuron death, unlike confusables on NMDA receptors, presynaptic kainate/GABA or AMPA trafficking.

qualifier: SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and DCC coupling to Rho GTPases
name: SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and DCC guidance signaling to Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are ROBO, ephrin and DCC receptor signaling that switches RAC1, CDC42 and RHOA activity in growth cones, distinct from confusables on netrin repulsion, L1 or commissural pathfinding.

qualifier: TNFR1 and TLR4-TRIF via RIP1 and linear ubiquitination
name: RIP1-mediated canonical NF-kappaB activation by TNFR1 and TLR4
rationale: Members describe TNFR1 and TLR4/TICAM1 signaling through RIP1, linear ubiquitination and TAK1/IKK recruitment to canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables on NF-kappaB inhibition, IRAK-dependent TLR7/8/9 or non-canonical NIK signaling.

name: Defective OGG1 glycosylase in oxidative base excision repair
rationale: All three members are OGG1 variant defects (localization, substrate binding, processing), separating the theme from confusables on NTHL1 defects, general glycosylase steps or gap filling.

name: Break-end resection and single-strand annealing repair
rationale: Members cover DSB end processing, SSA and RAD51 loading by BRCA2, while confusables concern NHEJ and break sensing or PALB2/BRCA1 HRR defects and SDSA.

qualifier: resolvins, protectins and maresins from DHA, DPA and EPA
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Every member synthesises resolvins, protectins or maresins from DHA, DPA or EPA, unlike confusables built on arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs, hepoxilins and leukotriene catabolism.

qualifier: lung and salivary gland via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Lung and salivary branching via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
rationale: Members regulate epithelial branching and mesenchymal proliferation with reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, trachea, salivary gland and limb bud, while confusables cover lung maturation (pneumocytes, saccules), prostate or pancreas/kidney development.
